correctness.rationale: Eulerian inclusion-exclusion gives E_p(X)≡Phi_p(X) mod p, and the differential recurrence gives E_{p+t}≡Phi_p E_{t+1} for 0<=t<=p-2. Since E_{t+1}(1)=(t+1)! is a p-adic unit, these factors are coprime mod p and lift uniquely and monically. Factorial valuation and Wilson give F_{p,t}(1)/p≡-1/(t+1) mod p. Translating X=1+Y yields an Eisenstein degree-p-1 polynomial; its uniformizer satisfies (alpha-1)^{p-1}/p≡1/(t+1) mod maximal ideal, so principal-unit Hensel adjustment yields a radical root of Y^{p-1}=p/(t+1). The p-1 residue unit classes give pairwise distinct Kummer degree-p-1 cyclic total tame fields and exhaust the classification. Independent Eulerian recurrence and coefficientwise mod-p checks tested all 22 pairs for p=3,5,7,11, including factorial-unit residues.

originality.rationale: Eulerian recurrences, local tame Kummer classification and related Eisenstein polynomial examples are classical; this theorem combines them to provide a single contiguous natural Eulerian index family realizing all p-1 local field isomorphism classes, with exact residue label. In the inspected primary results no such realization or stated implication of their formulas was identified.
residual_risks: Historical results may use a different Eulerian/Euler–Frobenius normalization, possibly implying local field realization through a not-yet-located theorem.

This sharp local-field census connects Eulerian descent enumeration with concrete p-adic isomorphism classes, beyond textbook existence of those fields.
